Third-party motion assets used by the StealthRDP homepage preview.

1) Lottie Web player
Source: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web
File: build/player/lottie_light.min.js
License: MIT
Copyright (c) 2015 Bodymovin

2) Globe Lottie animation
Source: https://github.com/csivitu/Gravitas
File: lottie/globe.json
License: MIT
Copyright (c) 2020 Computer Society of India - VIT University

3) Server Lottie animation
Source: https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/no_signal
File: assets/lottieassets/server.json
License: MIT
Copyright (c) [2022] [Bishwajeet Parhi]
